title: Agreement with the Language Indicator
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over bits, let $c_0$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a bit string, let $i$ be a natural number, and let $\mathrm{mode}$ be a Boolean. The Boolean value $\mathrm{wAns}(N,x,\mathrm{mode},c_0\ell(|x|),[K(c_0+1)+K+2]\ell(|x|))$, where $K$ is the code-width parameter of $N$, equals the indicator of membership of the paired encoding of $x$ and the binary expansion of $i$ in the indexed language $qLang(N,c_0,\mathrm{mode})$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over bits
